purpose: Permit only the staged, outcome-blind, data-free and noncircular creation of a frozen expected-value lockfile followed by a separately implemented official fixture compiler, without weakening any V1 PV5-B001 through PV5-B005 closure check, scientific semantic, fixture requirement, regression invariant, release gate or no-science boundary.

supersession_contract.sole_superseded_surface: The V1 prospective_one_time_fixture_compiler_governance sequence is replaced only to the extent necessary to insert a separately versioned non-authoritative lockfile-derivation transaction between literal primitive freezing and a rebuilt official compiler. V1 never authorized that derivation, so no bootstrap execution may rely on V1 alone.
supersession_contract.no_scientific_supersession: No V1 formula, operation order, dtype, shape, case ID/order, detector threshold, event comparator, match order, class, denominator, status, null rule, bootstrap rule, target, policy, family, run identity, compute cap, gate, claim, Phase2B state or formal claim ceiling is changed.
supersession_contract.conflict_rule: V2 controls only the A-B-C-D compiler-bootstrap transaction. Everywhere else V1 controls byte-semantically. Within the transaction, the stricter fail-closed rule applies. Any ambiguity is FAIL_BLOCKING and cannot be resolved by auditor discretion.

preserved_noncompensatory_scope.pass_rule: Every V1 closure and regression check and every compiler-fail finding must pass independently. A bootstrap lockfile, static PASS, compiler PASS, fixture hash or plausible numerical result cannot compensate for one failure.

immutable_scientific_and_regression_inva.bootstrap_rules_preserved: Every required 10000-element component array must be complete and finite; any incomplete required array propagates NOT_ESTIMABLE to every dependent object with no imputation, redraw, retry, compression or numeric interval. Any required empty M_b makes the affected family inference NOT_ESTIMABLE. T4 ZERO_ADDED_BOOTSTRAP remains the sole registered exception and cannot repair a failed point denominator.

staged_route.stage_barrier_rule: No stage may begin until every preceding stage has its exact required immutable artifacts, hashes, independent PASS and Root authorization or freeze. A failure spends the applicable invocation and returns to a new versioned release; it never skips forward.

normalization_algorithm: Require a drive-qualified absolute path and reject relative paths, UNC paths, device paths, extended-length aliases, alternate data streams, wildcard characters, trailing dot/space aliases and every dot or dot-dot segment.
Compute normcase(normpath(abspath(path))) and require exact equality to the registered normalized absolute string after the same transformation.

For every existing input and every existing parent component, lstat without following links; reject symbolic links, junctions, mount points or any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT; require st_nlink==1 for input files.
Open each input only after lstat, compare fstat device/inode/size to the pre-open identity, hash the open bytes, then repeat lstat and require unchanged device/inode/size and expected SHA-256.

Require each output parent to resolve to its exact registered parent on the same volume; reject a reparse component. Open new temporary and receipt files with exclusive creation. No glob, walk, discovery, directory enumeration or implicit current-directory resolution is allowed.

known_prior_final_prestate.rule: This V2 amendment does not authorize overwrite, deletion, movement or mutation of that prestate. Stage D remains denied unless a separate prior Root-controlled action and independent attestation make the registered final path absent before the rebuilt package static audit and keep it absent through invocation.

path_and_file_state_guards.race_rule: Immediately before each atomic rename, recheck that the registered final path remains absent. Use same-volume rename semantics that fail if the destination exists; never use replace-overwrite semantics.

primitive_rules: Every required sham/intervention r_E_stored and r_T_stored array for all 23 exact V1 cases is a complete 288000-byte little-endian binary64 buffer encoded as whitespace-free RFC4648 base64 and keyed by its uppercase SHA-256.
Every nonfinite test value uses an exact 64-bit IEEE-754 word and exact role/index; no JSON NaN or Infinity token is allowed.

Any prospectively authored filter coefficient is stored as exact little-endian binary64 bytes. Static authoring establishes bytes and hashes only; Stage B must independently derive and compare its scientific correctness.
No np.sin, np.cos, np.pi, filter design, detector, generator, RNG, clock, model, implementation, repository, data, R4 or outcome computation is permitted in Stage A.

The independent literal audit decodes every base64 value, verifies no whitespace, exact shape, byte count, dtype, byteorder, contiguity interpretation, uniqueness, case coverage and SHA-256, then Root freezes the exact bundle path/bytes/hash without editing it.

pre_execution_requirements: The literal bundle has an independent static PASS and exact Root freeze.
The specification, source, manifest, schema, environment lock and launcher are complete immutable bytes with exact path, byte count and uppercase SHA-256 in the derivation manifest.
An independent static audit returns PASS with zero unresolved findings for this exact release and confirms every Stage B output/receipt/spent path is absent.

Root issues the exact one-shot authorization only after that PASS; the authorization binds this amendment hash, literal freeze hash, every package hash, environment hash, invocation ID, exact command, path ledger and all required absent states.
stage_B_nonauthoritative_lockfile_deriva.ctypes_rule: ctypes may resolve only the exact kernel32 symbols listed above, solely for canonical-path, reparse/hardlink, stable-handle, exclusive-create, durable-flush and same-volume no-replace rename guards. No other DLL, symbol, callback, memory patch, process, registry, network or device capability is permitted. The static audit must enumerate every ctypes attribute and constant use and reject any unregistered symbol.
forbidden_imports_and_capabilities: Every module not in the exact allowlists, including importlib, subprocess, multiprocessing, threading, concurrent, random, secrets, time, datetime, socket, urllib, requests, pickle, joblib, sqlite3, winreg, glob, pathlib and tempfile.
Any dynamic import, eval, exec, compile, plugin discovery, environment-dependent module search, network, IPC, shell, child process, notebook, database, registry, clipboard or GUI access.
Any model, neurolib, brainmass, jax, repository-local module, CODE, PREFLIGHT, implementation manifest, Candidate V6, data, R4, output, checkpoint, cache, claim or outcome read.
Any protocol freeze, official compiler package, official fixture, STATE, run-count, compute, gate, advancement or claim write.

exact_launcher_and_cli_contract.rule: The release manifest resolves every .absolute path reference to exact_path_registry and binds one whitespace/quoting-normalized full command string and token array. No optional, positional, extra, reordered or environment-resolved argument is accepted.

derivation_rules: Consume only exact frozen literal bytes. Reconstruct no primitive from a formula, transcendental function, seed, compressed projection or external source.

Implement the V1 observation, sequential moment, variance, square root, affine a*x+b, common filtering, sham-only thresholds, official detector, three-match, class/consumption, pooling, bootstrap and canonical-record rules exactly under their V1 IDs.
Derive every coefficient and intermediate prospectively defined by the lockfile schema, compare any authored literal coefficient byte-for-byte, and fail on a mismatch.
The derivation source must not be byte-identical to, import, invoke, copy at runtime from, or write the later official compiler. Its formulas and checkpoints must be independently reviewable.
The candidate lockfile may contain expected values only. It cannot authorize, generate, overwrite or publish the official fixture and cannot be consumed by claims or science.
atomic_transaction: Complete no-write validation of all inputs, hashes, environment, path identities and required absent states.
Consume the authorization before the first derived numerical operation by exclusive creation, canonical validation and same-directory no-replace rename of derivation_spent_temp to derivation_spent.
Compute all lockfile content in memory; validate every exact schema, invariant and hash before opening candidate_lockfile_temp.
Exclusively create candidate_lockfile_temp, write canonical bytes, flush, fsync, close, reopen without link following, parse, schema-validate and rehash.
Recheck candidate_lockfile_final absent, then perform one same-directory atomic rename that fails if the destination exists.

On success atomically publish exactly derivation_success_receipt and leave derivation_failure_receipt absent. On failure publish exactly derivation_failure_receipt, leave candidate_lockfile_final and derivation_success_receipt absent, and remove only candidate_lockfile_temp if it was created.
Never overwrite, append, retry, reuse an invocation ID or modify the immutable spent receipt.
stage_B_nonauthoritative_lockfile_deriva.authorization_consumption: Root treats the invocation authorization as irrevocably spent at first process start, even if the spent marker or failure receipt cannot be written. Any interruption, exception, missing receipt or ambiguous state requires a new release ID and invocation ID after incident audit.

derived_lockfile_schema.canonicalization: UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False); arrays retain registered order; no NaN or Infinity JSON number.
hash_rules: Every raw array, coefficient array, observation, rescaled array, centered trace, filtered trace and RMS trace has an uppercase SHA-256 over exact little-endian bytes and an exact byte count.

Every event table, unmatched-array object, threshold provenance object, candidate ledger, accepted ledger, event-class ledger, row-consumption ledger, block record, condition record, pooling oracle, bootstrap oracle and case oracle has an explicit nonrecursive canonical JSON payload SHA-256.
Every hash envelope has exactly schema_id, algorithm, canonicalization_id, excluded_field, payload_byte_length and payload_sha256. excluded_field names exactly the one omitted enclosing field.

lockfile_payload_hash_envelope excludes only itself and includes every other top-level field. The candidate lockfile file SHA-256 is necessarily external and is captured by the success receipt, independent result audit and Root lockfile freeze; it is never recursively embedded.
No hash is learned from, refreshed by or repaired during the official compiler run.
derived_lockfile_schema.exact_case_registry_rule: case_registry_in_exact_order equals immutable_scientific_and_regression_invariants.exact_case_ids_in_order exactly; no missing, extra, duplicate, renamed or reordered case.
derived_lockfile_schema.status_and_null_rule: All values, enums, ranks, field sets, branch-specific nulls and first-failure reasons equal V1 exactly. An early-terminal null is never replaced by zero, false, an empty collection or an omitted field.
derived_lockfile_schema.no_authority_field: The lockfile must state authority_class NON_AUTHORITATIVE_DATA_FREE_BOOTSTRAP_CANDIDATE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE before Root freeze. Root freeze changes only external eligibility for official-compiler comparison and never changes lockfile bytes.

stage_B_independent_result_audit_and_roo.role_isolation: The derivation result auditor and Root lockfile freezer did not author or operate the derivation and will not operate the official compiler. Any conflicting role assignment is blocking.
result_audit_required_checks: Rehash every exact input and require the derivation failure receipt absent.
Verify invocation, environment, read/write ledger, absent-state preconditions, authorization consumption and no forbidden access.
Decode all literal inputs and independently recompute or transparently verify every coefficient, operation, intermediate, event table, ledger, status, pool, bootstrap oracle and canonical hash.
Validate every lockfile field, type, enum, null, order, ID, case, provenance entry and hash; zero unresolved findings are allowed.
Confirm the candidate lockfile has no official-fixture, scientific-evidence, implementation, preflight, claim, gate, advancement or run-count authority.
stage_B_independent_result_audit_and_roo.failure_rule: Any mismatch, stale byte, missing or extra path, role overlap, unresolved value, receipt defect or forbidden access rejects the candidate lockfile and spends the attempt. Root does not edit or partially accept it.

package_requirements: Bind exact path, byte count and uppercase SHA-256 for this amendment, V1, static FAIL receipt, bootstrap adjudication, literal bundle/freeze, frozen lockfile/Root freeze and every official package file.

Use an independently implemented source at a distinct path and with a distinct SHA-256 from derivation_source; prohibit importing, invoking or runtime-reading any Stage B source, manifest, schema or launcher.
Consume the frozen lockfile read-only and treat every expected byte/value/hash as immutable. Recompute rather than copy all derived content needed for comparison.

Use V1 exact IDs, zero-based ranks, LITTLE_ENDIAN, status enums, field sets, base64 input encoding, all 23 case IDs/order, complete ledger wrappers/hashes, correct fixture envelope schema and exact success/failure/spent receipts.
Bind complete host/interpreter/package/native-library/thread identity and apply the same exact path/link/hardlink guards and atomic no-overwrite transaction rules as Stage B.
Close V6FC-SA-B001 through V6FC-SA-B008 with no compensating pass and no weakening of PV5-B001 through PV5-B005.
stage_C_official_compiler_rebuild_and_st.official_import_and_environment_rule: The official package freezes an exact import list and complete environment identity at least as restrictive and complete as Stage B. ctypes, if retained, is limited to the same exact Win32 symbol allowlist and path/atomicity purpose. Any additional import, symbol, package, executable, native dependency, thread source or environment value is blocking.

exact_launcher_and_cli_contract.rule: The official release manifest resolves every .absolute path reference, freezes the exact full command string and token array, and rejects every optional, extra, reordered, positional or PATH-resolved argument.

stage_C_official_compiler_rebuild_and_st.static_audit_prohibitions: No import or execution of either compiler or launcher; no Candidate V6 artifact other than an absence-only check of official_fixture_temp and official_fixture_final; no CODE, PREFLIGHT, implementation manifest, data, R4, outcomes or directory enumeration.
stage_C_official_compiler_rebuild_and_st.root_release_rule: A static PASS does not execute or release the compiler. Root must separately issue official_authorization binding the exact package, frozen lockfile, environment, command, absent paths, invocation ID and receipt schemas.

execution_rules: Perform all no-write environment, hash, path, role, authorization and absent-state checks first; consume authorization before the first derived numerical operation using the immutable spent-marker transaction.

Decode the frozen literal bundle, independently recompute every V1 coefficient, source observation, affine value, processed trace, threshold, detector table, match, ledger, pool, bootstrap oracle, record and hash, and compare each exact value to the frozen lockfile.
Any mismatch fails before official_fixture_temp is opened. No tolerance, learning, lockfile update, fallback, reuse of bootstrap output as computed output, or favorable substitution is permitted.
Build the complete official fixture in memory using the exact V1 fixture schema and self-contained base64 raw buffers; validate all fields, cases, ledgers, statuses, nulls and hashes.

Exclusively create official_fixture_temp, write canonical bytes, flush, fsync, close, reopen, parse, deeply validate and rehash; recheck official_fixture_final absent; then perform one same-directory no-replace atomic rename.

On success atomically publish official_success_receipt and leave official_failure_receipt absent. On failure publish official_failure_receipt, leave official_fixture_final and official_success_receipt absent, and remove only official_fixture_temp if created.
The authorization is spent at first process start even if no spent or failure receipt can be written; no retry or same-invocation continuation is lawful.
postrun_audit_requirements: Independently rehash all released inputs, frozen lockfile, success/spent receipts and official fixture and require the failure receipt absent.
Independently decode and recompute every fixture primitive, intermediate, ledger, status and hash without importing or executing the official or bootstrap compiler.
Verify exact receipt read/write ledgers, environment, command, absent-state evidence, atomic publication, authorization consumption and zero forbidden access.
Issue PASS only with zero blocking and zero unresolved findings. PASS authorizes only Root consideration of binding the exact fixture into a still-unfrozen Candidate V6 package.

receipt_and_authorization_schemas.canonical_receipt_rule: All receipts use CANONICAL_JSON_SHA256_V6 semantics and a nonrecursive payload envelope. Each final receipt file SHA-256 is reported externally and bound by the independent post-transaction audit.
receipt_and_authorization_schemas.success_failure_exclusivity: Exactly one success or failure receipt may exist for an invocation; the spent receipt must exist once derivation begins. Both success and failure, neither after a completed process, a mutable receipt, or a reused invocation is a governance incident and FAIL_BLOCKING.

prewrite_failures: missing, extra, stale, mutable or hash-mismatched input
environment, executable, package, native library, locale, byteorder, CPU feature or thread mismatch
path normalization, containment, reparse, hardlink, identity, absent-state or race failure
literal decode, shape, dtype, byte count, coefficient or primitive hash mismatch
formula, operation-order, intermediate, detector, event, ledger, pooling, bootstrap, schema, enum, null, ordering or hash mismatch
missing, extra, duplicate, colliding, renamed or reordered case, field, row, identity or hash
any inability to prove exact deterministic behavior
fail_closed_semantics.transaction_failures: A write, flush, fsync, close, reopen, parse, validation, hash, rename or receipt failure spends the attempt. No final output may be accepted without an independent audit of a complete success and spent trail.
fail_closed_semantics.no_repair_during_run: No code path may patch inputs, edit expected values, choose a new tolerance, regenerate a lockfile, downgrade an error, omit a case, shrink a family, impute a bootstrap value, change a schema, retry or resume.
fail_closed_semantics.failure_authority: Failure creates no evidence, fixture, lockfile freeze, release, claim, gate, advancement or right to rerun.

disjointness: derivation_author, derivation_static_auditor, derivation_operator and derivation_result_auditor are pairwise distinct
root_lockfile_freezer is not derivation_author or derivation_operator
official_compiler_author, official_static_auditor, official_operator and official_postrun_auditor are pairwise distinct
role_separation.binding_rule: Every future release, authorization and receipt binds stable role IDs. Unbound, overlapping or changed role assignments are blocking and cannot be waived after execution.

allowed_change_scope: Prospective literal-byte bundle and its independent static hash freeze.
A separate non-authoritative data-free lockfile derivation package, candidate lockfile, receipts, independent result audit and Root freeze.
A rebuilt official compiler package closing V6FC-SA-B001 through V6FC-SA-B008.
An official one-shot atomic fixture publication and independent post-run audit.
Candidate V6 propagation strictly limited to V1 PV5-B001 through PV5-B005 closure after the official fixture passes; that later propagation requires its own authorized audit.
prohibited: Any model, simulation, scientific run, parameter search, data, R4, checkpoint, outcome or production implementation access.
Any new target, metric, favorable scalar, p-value, family/member, RNG call, seed, run identity, dose, policy, verifier condition, grade, gate, advancement path, claim or human-transfer statement.
Any use of literal bytes, candidate or frozen lockfile, compiler output, receipt or fixture as scientific evidence, result, effect estimate, claim support, gate evidence or advancement evidence.
Any direct write to PROTOCOL/PROTOCOL_FREEZE_V6.json, STATE, CODE, PREFLIGHT, implementation manifests, data, R4, outcomes, run counts, compute receipts, claims or gates under this amendment.
Any reuse of the failed compiler package or its execution command. Its immutable static FAIL receipt remains historical evidence only.

activation_and_gate_state.this_amendment_activation: The exact V2 path, byte count and externally reported SHA-256 must be bound by every Stage A-D release, authorization, receipt, audit and freeze. This file alone authorizes no execution.

immutability.amendment_policy: Any byte change or transaction-scope change requires a separately named prospective amendment version before any affected authoring, derivation or execution.
immutability.self_hash_policy: Compute and report uppercase SHA-256 over exact final bytes externally; do not embed it recursively.
